events.title_original: Sheikha Hind bint Hamad Al-Thani Elected Vice President of Qatar Olympic Committee
events.summary: Doha, November 09 (QNA) - The Qatar Olympic Committee's (QOC) General Assembly on Monday elected HE Sheikha Hind bint Hamad Al-Thani as vice president of the committee during its 2026 extraordinary meeting, chaired by HE President of QOC Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al-Thani. During the meeting, HE Mohamed bin Yousef Al Mana was named vice president of the committee, succeeding HE Dr. Thani bin Abdulrahman Al Kuwari, who decided not to seek another term. In this regard, QOC extended its profound thanks and gratitude to HE Dr. Al Kuwari, praising his invaluable efforts and contributions throughout his tenure, and wishing him all the best.  （原文待翻译）
